reports.title: My players’ news
reports.note: Choose your franchise to see its news.
reports.source: Source: MFL player news · rostered players only
reports.how: Profiles are fetched only for rostered players, one second apart, and cached per local calendar day. Age is MFL’s bio age. Open article hands off to MFL in your browser; nothing is submitted. Posted times are estimated from MFL’s elapsed wording at the fetch time, in your local time zone. Minutes show a minute, hours show about an hour, and days show only a date. Unrecognized wording or a missing fetch time has no posted time.
